# maas_reserved_ip (Resource)

Provides a resource to manage MAAS reserved IPs (static DHCP leases). Requires MAAS 3.6 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "maas_reserved_ip" "my_server_ip" {
  ip          = "10.0.0.50"
  mac_address = "aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff"
  subnet      = maas_subnet.example.id
  comment     = "Server static lease"
}

resource "maas_reserved_ip" "another_ip" {
  ip          = "10.0.0.51"
  mac_address = "11:22:33:44:55:66"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip` (String) The IP address to reserve.
- `mac_address` (String) The MAC address of the host to bind the reserved IP to.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) A description of the reserved IP.
- `subnet` (Number) The ID of the subnet the reserved IP belongs to. If not set, MAAS auto-detects it from the IP address.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Reserved IPs can be imported by their ID.
$ terraform import maas_reserved_ip.my_server_ip 42
```
